This guide explains how to get a copy of an existing registration certificate. If you don’t have a registration certificate yet, you mustregister your addressto get one.
Request itonlineor in personfrom theBürgeramt. It’s free online, or €10in person.

title: Online
text: Request a Meldebescheinigung online You can download yourMeldebescheinigungas a PDF. To use this service, you need… Aregistered addressin Berlin AneID, like a plasticresidence permit, a German passport, or aPersonalausweis

title: In person
text: Get aBürgeramtappointment. You can go to anyBürgeramtin Berlin. When you go to your appointment, bring…Your passport orPersonalausweis€10for the fee. You can usually pay byGirocard, Visa or Mastercard. It depends on theBürgeramt. Your passport orPersonalausweis €10for the fee. You can usually pay byGirocard, Visa or Mastercard. The extended registration certificate (erweiterte Meldebescheinigung)has more detailsthan the normalMeldebescheinigung. It shows… Your previous addresses Your registered spouse and children You rarely need anerweiterte Meldebescheinigung. The regularMeldebescheinigungis usually good enough.

title: How to get it in person
text: Book an appointmentand go to theBürgeramtin person. Bring your passport orPersonalausweis.

title: How to get it by email
text: You can request anerweiterte Meldebescheinigungby email. They will mail it to you.1 Find yourBürgeramt.On eachBürgeramt’s page, you can find their email and bank details. Send them €10bybank transfer. In the payment description, write “erweiterte Meldebescheinigung” and your name. Email them, and ask for anerweiterte Meldebescheinigung.
